Definition: pleasure; hence (abstractly) desire; concretely, a valuable thing; hence (by extension) a matter (as something in mind)
BiblicalUsage: Chephets is pleasure and desire, what a person delights in or longs for, and Scripture uses it for both God and man. Samuel tells Saul that the Lord delights in obedience more than in burnt offering, Ecclesiastes warns of days when a man finds no pleasure in them, and the psalmist says God's works are sought out by all who have pleasure in them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what we delight in shows what we worship, so I ask God to make my pleasure His pleasure. My position is simple: a heart that delights in obedience will never be far from Him.
